chapter: Melvin Moore, Hammond and the New York trip
title: First trip to the Apollo and Willard Alexander's plan
summary: Love saw Melvin at the Apollo; Fields explains Alexander planned to leave William Morris and Basie asks why he would go back to Tulsa.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: We were going to the Apollo Theatre--
I saw Melvin at the Apollo with you.

because we went on, I think after that first appearance, I think I appeared in New York in that chain of theatres that they do twice a year, after that first trip. But I wasn't under the banner of Willard.
You see, I didn't now, but Count, I think knew, Willard had a dream--

--that he was going to pull out from William Morris as soon as his contract was out, and he was trying to deal some bands to go along. Basie talked--we knew each other before we got up there to be big, but Basie is one fellow that's been the same all the time anyway--but we knew each other when, and he says why do you want to go back to Tulsa?
